E3412

`core.net.{method}()` is not available at comptime.

What

`core.net.{method}()` is not available at comptime.

Why

Only `core.net.fetch(url, sha256:)` is supported at compile time as a Tier-1 hermetic effect. Other `core.net` methods are not planned for comptime access. A `jet build` or `jet run` run reports this comptime-tier diagnostic.

Fix

Use `core.net.fetch(url, sha256: "…")` for content-hash-pinned downloads.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3412: tests/ui/impure_net_stub.stderr.

Error [jet.ComptimeNetUnavailable]: `core.net.tcp_connect()` is not available at comptime.

  6 |         conn :: comptime { net.tcp_connect("build.example.com:443") }
    |                                ^^^^^^^^^^^
